biggest_catch: Rewards are Cashback Vouchers (trading-fee rebates that only pay out a portion of fees when YOU trade) — not withdrawable free crypto — and Phemex publishes no official per-lesson dollar figure, so the catalog's '$2-$10 per quiz' is unverified.
catches: Official page: 'receive Cashback Vouchers (free crypto) for every lesson you pass. Each time you make a trade, these vouchers will give you a portion of your fees back!' — the reward is a fee rebate, not cash in hand.
Phemex publishes no official per-lesson amount (third-party bonus sites claim ~1 USDT per lesson, which is not an official figure).
Rewards only available to users in North America, UK, Australia, Germany, Japan, South Korea (per official Help Center); KYC completion is required before any reward is issued.
Crypto value fluctuates; vouchers have their own terms/expiry in the Phemex rewards system.

steps: Register a Phemex account and complete KYC (required before any reward is issued).
Go to Learn → Learn & Earn on phemex.com and choose a course; click Earn on the lesson.
Watch the video or read the lesson material, then click 'Take the quiz!'.
Answer all questions correctly (you can retry after a mistake) — the reward is a Cashback Voucher for that lesson.
Understand that the voucher is not cash: it gives you a portion of your trading fees back each time you make a trade on Phemex.
timing: Voucher issued after KYC completion and a passed quiz for each lesson; voucher value realized only when you trade (fee rebates).
